Steel village guard with open-faced gray helmet, short red cape, steel sword and brown shield with red cross. THREE swimming scissor-kick poses, torso tilted 55 degrees forward RIGHT, head up, equipment retained in hands. Arms keep sword/shield near chest without hiding all leg motion. CELL3: far leg extends STRAIGHT BACK-LEFT and near thigh angles DOWN with bent knee. Upper and lower kicks must form strong separated silhouettes; knees tucked in middle frame is essential. Clear human joints.
